timeline.event: ACCC commenced informal review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Timeline suspended pending receipt of further information. Former proposed decision date for announcement of ACCC's findings (10 November 2022) is delayed.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
ACCC is awaiting information from Woolworths. Former provisional date for announcement of findings (23 March) is delayed.
Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC’s findings (20 April) delayed at Woolworths' request.
ACCC announced that it opposed the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Woolworths Group Limited (Woolworths) is proposing to acquire the independent supermarket operating as SUPA IGA Karabar. Woolworths and SUPA IGA Karabar both supply groceries in the broader Queanbeyan region (encompassing Karabar and Jerrabomberra). The ACCC previously opposed Woolworths’ proposed acquisition of the Karabar Supermarket in 2008 (then trading under the “Supabarn” banner). Further detail on the ACCC’s 2008 merger review, including the Public Competition Assessment, is available on the ACCC’s Public Mergers Register here .
